entities.name: Nnr NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme
observations: Sequence is 480 aa with estimated molecular mass 52.5 kDa and pI 6.21.
Closest reviewed homologs are bifunctional Nnr proteins with about 40–41% identity and 97–98% query coverage.
The sequence has a YjeF_N domain at residues 22–182 and a Carb_kinase-like C-terminal domain at residues 227–470.
Homology-supported function is NAD(P)H-hydrate epimerization plus ADP-dependent dehydration of (S)-NAD(P)HX.
Potassium ion is reported as a cofactor in close reviewed homologs.

entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair reactions
observations: ADP-dependent dehydration: (6S)-NADHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADH + H(+).
ADP-dependent dehydration: (6S)-NADPHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADPH + H(+).
The dehydration reactions regenerate NADH or NADPH while converting ADP to AMP and phosphate.

entities.name: Nnr potassium cofactor
observations: Close reviewed Nnr homologs are annotated to bind one potassium ion per subunit.
